title: NormalizedEntityDocument
description: Partial CEL-facing normalized entities for GitHub issues, pull requests and Discussions; GitLab issues and merge requests; and Jira issues.

timestamp.description: UTC with exactly nine fractional-second digits, so lexical string comparison equals chronological comparison in CEL.

structural_id.description: Immutable source-system identifier or a stable source-backed action identifier. Numeric provider IDs use base-10 without leading zeroes.

repository.description: Canonical navigation path of a forge repository/project, with provider-preserved case; not an identity input.

role.description: Authorization Contract v1 role vocabulary (independent copy).

system.description: Authoritative source system and overlay selector.

host.description: Lowercase DNS name, with :port only when the HTTPS port is not 443.

repository.description: GitHub lowercase owner/repository or GitLab canonical path_with_namespace.

repository_id.description: Immutable GitHub GraphQL node ID or GitLab global numeric project ID.

project.description: Jira project key; mutable navigation value.

unknown.description: Serialized unresolved field. The CEL binding maps this marker to CEL unknown; the marker object is never exposed to CEL.

oneOf.description: Current display login; untrusted and mutable.

role.description: Verified effective human role, none for a provider-classified bot, or unknown before human role resolution.

bot_role.description: Registered bot role, null after a completed no-match, or unknown before resolution; absent for humans.

role_verified.description: True when role lookup completed, including a bot no-match; false on lookup failure; unknown before lookup.

actor_ref.description: Shared ADR 0107 actor representation for every person in the entity model. Humans omit bot_role; bots have role none and a resolved, null, or unknown bot_role.

admitted_actor.description: The shared actor shape with verified identity and current-revision admission; human bot_role is still absent.

id.description: Stable source-backed action ID; a body action uses entity.source_id.

created_at.description: Immutable source time: creation for body and comment, submission for review, application for label_application.

oneOf.description: Time of the current revision: the latest authenticated edit when the source records one, otherwise equal to created_at. Never earlier than created_at. Always equal to created_at for label_application.

actor.description: Verified actor under the provider authorization source selected by Authorization Contract v2.

is_entity_author.description: Contextual routing aid on this action, never an actor identity field or authorization evidence.

oneOf.description: Complete, authorized current-revision text after the filter pipeline identified by view.filter_version; empty text is valid.

First whitespace-delimited token of the first line of the authorized, filtered current revision when it is a command token (begins with '/', 2 to 64 characters, no whitespace), otherwise null. Whitespace is the explicit code-point set in the README (Unicode White_Space plus U+FEFF), encoded as an explicit character class so every regular-expression dialect agrees. A bare '/' or a slash-prefixed token over 64 characters is not a command token and yields null. Required for body, comment, and review.

thread_id.description: Source thread ID for a threaded comment, null when source confirms it is unthreaded, or unknown when membership is unresolved.

parent_id.description: Discussion thread-root message ID. On a root comment it equals id; on a reply it identifies the root.

oneOf.description: Current review state. Required for review.
Applied label name. Required for label_application.

id.description: Source thread ID, scoped to this entity.

comment_ids.description: Known admitted entity.comments IDs in source thread order; coverage.thread_comments records the unknown remainder.

resolved.description: Native thread resolution, null when inapplicable, or unknown when unresolved.

outdated.description: Native outdated state, null when the source has no equivalent; never inferred from the current diff.

review_id.description: Associated formal review action ID when source-backed, null when none or inapplicable.

location.description: Source-backed diff location, null for a general discussion, or unknown when not fetched.

path.description: Source-backed repository-relative path after the snapshot path-safety pipeline.

oneOf.description: null only when the source reports that the head repository no longer exists.
Source-reported cross-repository flag; independent of head_repository availability.

kind.description: Supported provider/kind pairs are constrained at the document root.

id.description: Canonical fullsend entity ID derived from source.system, source.host, kind, and source_id using the README's component encoding. Conformance checks recompute the exact value.

source_id.description: Immutable provider entity ID: GitHub GraphQL node ID or GitLab/Jira global database ID as a base-10 string.

number.description: Positive numeric component of the current human reference: GitHub number, GitLab IID, or Jira issue-key suffix.

oneOf.description: Complete, authorized current-revision title after the filter pipeline identified by view.filter_version.
Source-authenticated creator. Routing data only; not authorization evidence.

labels.description: Known label names only; coverage.labels determines whether the remainder is unknown. The CEL binding must not expose this array as a complete list when coverage is incomplete.

body.description: One admitted body action, null when the source confirms no body, or unknown until the current revision is resolved.

comments.description: Known admitted comments only; coverage.comments describes the unknown remainder.

label_applications.description: Known attributable applications of current labels; coverage.label_applications describes the unknown remainder.

reviews.description: Known submitted formal reviews on a change proposal; coverage.reviews describes the unknown remainder.

threads.description: Known source comment threads; coverage.threads describes the unknown remainder.

key.description: Contextual human reference: Jira issue key, GitHub #number, GitLab issue #IID or MR !IID. Not immutable identity.

checks.description: Known current-head check results only. coverage.checks describes the unknown remainder; inapplicable outside change proposals.

reviewers.description: Known current reviewer assignments or standings; coverage.reviewers describes the unknown remainder.

current_approvals.description: Known currently recorded, admitted approvals; coverage.current_approvals describes the unknown remainder.

assignees.description: Known current source assignees; coverage.assignees tracks the unknown remainder. The assigner's admission is separate from the assignee's role.

reactions.description: Known entity-level reactions with admitted actors; coverage.reactions tracks the remainder.

thread_comments.description: Exactly one coverage row per known thread, keyed by thread_id.

check_logs.description: Exactly one row per known check, keyed by check_id; each direction has independent coverage.

check_annotations.description: Exactly one row per known check; unsupported if the forge has no check-bound annotations.

extension_lists.description: Independent partial-list coverage for selected extension values.

filter_version.description: Active version of the common content-filter pipeline used for every concrete title, action text, check name, report text, annotation text, or check log line in this view. Host-only metadata.

view.description: Host-only authorization and filtering view metadata. No predicate result or acquisition plan is encoded here.

oneOf.description: One complete filtered source log line; empty lines are valid.
The source has no per-line timestamp.

ascending.description: Contiguous known prefix from the earliest source log line; remaining membership follows coverage.check_logs.

descending.description: Contiguous known prefix from the latest source log line; remaining membership follows coverage.check_logs.

head_sha.description: Source-reported revision, which must match the current change-proposal head.

repository_path.description: Filtered, validated repository-relative path of a check annotation.

check_annotation.description: One forge-published, check-bound file finding. Text is fully filtered or unknown.

annotations.description: Known check-bound file findings; coverage.check_annotations describes the unknown remainder.

check_annotation_coverage.description: Exactly one row per known check, keyed by check_id.

team_ref.description: Source-identified team review request; a team is not an actor or an authorization verdict.

reviewer.description: One current source-backed reviewer assignment or review standing; not a formal review action or the population eligible under approval rules.

actor.description: Current approving actor, admitted under the selected harness authorization policy.

is_entity_author.description: Contextual routing aid on this action, never an actor identity field or authorization evidence.

current_approval.description: A currently recorded approval, keyed by source actor ID; it need not count toward the forge approval requirement.

approval.description: Current forge approval requirement only, evaluated for this proposal revision after harness actor admission; independent of CI, conflicts, and other merge blockers.

extension_atom.description: Selected, typed scalar, option, or identified ADR 0107 actor; arbitrary source JSON is not a CEL value.

extension_value.description: A configured typed projection. Null is a source-confirmed unset value; unknown is unresolved.

source_key.description: Immutable or stable source field ID or API property key, never a display name.

source_path.description: Optional JSON Pointer selecting a declared typed value from a structured source property.

extension_entry.description: One explicitly declared extension. A known value requires its own trusted current-revision provenance; it never borrows the containing record actor.

custom_fields.description: Schema-defined provider custom fields keyed by configured CEL alias.

properties.description: API key/value properties keyed by configured CEL alias; distinct from custom fields.

extensions.description: Reusable source-defined data on an entity or source record; absent when no extensions are declared for that record.

extension_list_coverage.description: One host-only coverage row per declared list-valued extension, keyed by record, category, and alias.

known_actor.description: Identified person using the same actor shape; identity does not by itself authorize the assignment.

lifecycle.description: Source-backed lifecycle events. Merge fields apply only to change proposals. The state field remains the portable current state.

source_status.description: Source-native status name and category, independent of portable entity.state.

work_item.description: Provider-native issue details supplementing portable entity.state.

reaction.description: Source-backed reaction on the entity itself; a login-only API response requires immutable-actor enrichment.

changed_file.description: One changed path. Patch is a complete filtered diff, null when source confirms none, or unknown when unfetched or truncated.
